title: Boston tunnel ceiling: match evidence to duration and use
focus: A short acceptance test cannot close a long-duration load claim without a justified model of time-dependent behavior.

sources.title: NTSB Highway Accident Report HAR-07/02
sources.locator: Executive summary; Conclusions, Probable Cause, printed p. 107
sources.limitations: Relevant sections inspected; this is not a reconstruction of every event or finding.

facts.statement: The NTSB attributed the ceiling collapse to epoxy anchor adhesive with inadequate creep resistance under sustained loading.
Its findings connected material selection and approval to insufficient consideration of long-term adhesive behavior.

retrospective.boundary: Adhesive, anchors, concrete, sustained ceiling load, installation, supplier information, design approval, and inspection form the support system.
interfaces: Material qualification → structural use: load duration and environment must match the claimed application.
Installation acceptance → service inspection: passing a local test does not remove degradation mechanisms.

decision.question: Can a satisfactory short pull test establish the service-life claim?
options: Treat load exceedance during the test as sufficient margin.
Identify creep, aging, installation variability, and the evidence needed for the sustained load.
decision.recommendation: Require a duration-appropriate basis and a review of changes in product or use.
decision.uncertainty: A proposed accelerated test needs a justified relation to service behavior; it is not automatically conservative.

rows: Separate short proof load from sustained demand
Define preparation, cure, temperature, and variability
Set detectable degradation and response criteria

questions: What hidden assumption connects a brief test to a long service life?
Which supplier or installation change should reopen qualification?
Explain why a passed test may be valid evidence for a narrower claim.
answer_signals: Defines applicability rather than rejecting testing wholesale.
Connects procurement, installation, and maintenance evidence.
retrospective.transfer_exercise: Synthetic: an adhesive attachment passes a one-minute proof test but must support a constant load for years. Draft the unresolved claim and evidence plan.
retrospective.limits: No structural analysis or adhesive lifetime prediction was executed; this is not a construction acceptance basis.
